name: kagaz
description: Paper tools that never leave your browser. Browser-only PDF tools with no server.
author: Amit Jena (https://namastevis.in)

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run verify && npm test

//: No "type": "module" here on purpose — shared/*.js and vendor/*.js are UMD, and
declaring the package as ESM makes Node refuse to require them. Tests use .mjs instead.
The site itself has zero dependencies — vendor/ is committed and nothing is fetched.
Everything under scripts except `eslint` runs on a bare Node install, so `git clone`
and `npm run check` works without ever running `npm install`.
`sharp` is optional. If it happens to be present, tests/stress.mjs uses it to exercise
the real image codec; without it a stub covers the same branches.
